notes.title: Prehistoric Kingdom - Patch (EA 1.15.50)
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/d5f7962d1ae6db01c315095c7eb7ae0a089ab738.png"][/img][/p][p]Welcome, [b]Park Managers[/b]![/p][p]This patch aims to fix various issues from Update 15 while adding a few more animations to the animals. This includes new tall feeder animations for the hadrosaurs, also allowing them to browse from short trees. We've also cleaned up their drinking and low eat animations.[/p][p]The team are still working on Update 15.1 so keep your eyes peeled for that in the next few weeks![/p][p] [/p][h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][h2]Additions[/h2][p]
[b]Animals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added more additive and idle fidget animations to Gallimimus[/p][/*][*][p]Added tall feeder and tree-browsing support to hadrosaurs[/p][/*][*][p]Added grazing idle animation to hadrosaurs[/p][/*][*][p]Added courtship animation to:[/p][list][*][p]Camarasaurus[/p][/*][*][p]Lambeosaurus[/p][/*][*][p]Pachyrhinosaurus[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added threaten animation to: [/p][list][*][p]Deinocheirus[/p][/*][*][p]Ursus[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added various missing vocal animations to:[/p][list][*][p]Argentinosaurus, Brachiosaurus[/p][/*][*][p]Deinocheirus[/p][/*][*][p]Nasutoceratops, Pachyrhinosaurus, Protoceratops and Triceratops[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added unique growls to Nasutoceratops[/p][/*][*][p]Added missing sounds to various animations introduced in Update 15 (some threaten sfx still absent!)[/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][p][/p][p][b]Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased guest spawning rates across all difficulties[/p][/*][*][p]Dung degradation has been rebalanced to be much faster, previous tuning was based on incorrect units, causing almost no degradation over time[/p][/*][*][p]When Dung is disabled in settings, all dung in park will rapidly degrade[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Animals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted exhibit crowding sizes[/p][list][*][p]Coelophysis: 150m² > 250m²[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Adjusted animal iridescence visuals[/p][list][*][p]Lowered Oviraptor baseline iridescence[/p][/*][*][p]Drastically cut iridescence intensity during night time[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]After successfully mating, if parent fertility would result in 0 offspring, a notification is generated[/p][/*][*][p]Family Group Leaders will now observe the nutrition and hydration levels of infants and prioritize eating and drinking based on group need[/p][/*][*][p]Updated hadrosaur low eat and drinking animations[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI/UX[/b][/p][list][*][p]Camera track transitions have been improved, with the snap->bounce effect being drastically smoothed out[/p][/*][*][p]Improved item rotation sensitivity[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Wooden staff gates now have a unique open/close sound[/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes [/h2][p]
[b]Crashes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a crash when terraforming near the edge of the map[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Critical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an invalid memory access when enclosures were up against the far sides of the map[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed another potential source of animal fuzz explosions[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed errors in animal skeleton initialization that could destabilize the game[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that set the animal limit at 1024 instead of the intended 4096[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed nav agents being able to pass into illegitimate triangles that are inescapable.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Animals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Strengthened ‘pregnancy’ logic checks, which should be more accurately reported in the animal GUI[/p][/*][*][p]Added a potential fix to some larger animals not reaching full maturity[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed clutch and breeding data for Apatosaurus[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rigging issue that caused awkward ankle positioning across all animals when turning[/p][/*][*][p]Limited the angle at which animals can adapt to the ground[/p][/*][*][p]BluffCharge state will no longer disrespect line of sight nav boundaries[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Animal Groups not loading in under certain circumstances[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Flee State being appended at the wrong time causing errors in multithreaded state processing[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed “Pregnancy Failed” notification missing localization assets[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Environment[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed grass splatmaps for the starting boreal and coastal maps[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Guests[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that made binoculars vision cone narrower than intended[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Staff[/b][/p][list][*][p]Staff Breaks are now centrally delegated, preventing too many staff members from going on break at the same time[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Construction[/b][/p][list][*][p]All pre-built facilities for starting saves have now been aligned to the grid[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed modular quick scale resetting object height if it was currently stacking on another object[/p][/*][/list][p][b]UI/UX[/b][/p][list][*][p]Potentially fixed a GUI exception causing inability to switch feeders to a different feed type[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue causing undo/redo buttons on the Main HUD to not properly refresh when using Undo/Redo through the keybinds[/p][/*][/list][h2]Performance[/h2][list][*][p]Minor CPU Optimizations[/p][/*][*][p]GPU rendering optimization for animals that didn’t need tessellation[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced unnecessary logging[/p][/*][*][p]Heavily optimized the Modular Style menu[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Prehistoric Kingdom - Update 15 (1.15.48)
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/0251ad851f23c6b0ca417b98ed643fbc8239bbae.png"][/img][/p][p]Welcome, [b]Park Managers[/b]![/p][p][b]Update 15[/b] is now available! This major releases adds two new species, breeding and paleobotany. Alongside these features are new feeders and enrichment, updated landscape tools, an improved global grid, reworked Animal Nursery and new animal milestones. To top it all off, herbivores can also now browse on foliage![/p][p]If you're yet to try the game, [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/666150/Prehistoric_Kingdom/?snr=1_2108_9__2107"]we're currently 30% off[/url]! It's a great time to start building your kingdom's next generation.[/p][p][/p][h1]Update 15 Features[/h1][p align="start"][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][h2]New Species[/h2][p]Unlock two fast and feathery dinosaurs - [b]Oviraptor[/b] and [b]Gallimimus[/b]! Like the other animals, these Cretaceous chickens feature seamless growth and adorable (or scrungly) babies.[/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="iyE_QRmrC2c;full"][/previewyoutube][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/850fb535a2f0c550fd44c5ccc046882045dbcf32.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Breeding, Courtship & Guarding[/h2][p]Throughout the year, animals experience a [b]breeding season[/b] that allows them to partake in courtship, reproduce and maintain a nest or birthing bed built by the player.[/p][p align="start"]To maximise the amount of offspring an animal can have, players can create animals with high fertility from the Animal Nursery. Creating creatures from a young maturity at slower growth speeds yields the best result once they reach sexual maturity.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/475db343a88d0524ea07b0d9c4dbfccb39574e64.png"][/img][/p][p]Once the breeding season hits, males will attempt to court females to varying degrees of success. If they get rejected, they will be out until next season. [/p][p]If courtship is successful, the female will fall pregnant as long as they have a compatible nest or birthing bed in their habitat. [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/26d8e0aabefdd1a0f6525ce6bd67e1d6749b7de3.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Animals will guard and manage their nests - attempting to both scare off any threats and maintain healthy embryos. If they have to wander too far for food and water, it's even possible for their offspring to die early.[/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/d58d5143-6561-4923-b8fb-55256cae895e/NestVariationBear.png?format=2500w"][/img][/p][p]Once animals are born, they'll randomly take on the traits of their parents. If you're [i]really[/i] determined, you can even selectively breed animals to make them larger or smaller than the expected variation range of their species. Have fun![/p][p][/p][h2]Paleobotany & Era-Appropriate Foliage[/h2][p]From the Excavations menu, players can discover [b]over 30 species of Mesozoic plants[/b] to make their dinosaurs feel right at home.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/8f165f31-ea35-4be0-818d-53d43ef55b99/PaleoScrubland1.jpg?format=2500w"][/img][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/731d1765-158f-447a-9177-48ff152518ab/DiaryJune2025_PaleoEnvironment_Wetland_1.png?format=2500w"][/img][/p][p]Placing plants from the appropriate era (Mesozoic for dinosaurs, Cenozoic for mammals) will reward animals with additional points to increase their popularity with guests. It is not a hard requirement![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//30171105/2e5ecf35912fcc827c6e175c6b9d7bbcb38bc6b5.png"][/img][/p][h2]Browsing Behavior[/h2][p]Herbivores can now [b]browse from foliage[/b] to increase their enrichment levels! If their hunger is above 70%, they'll occasionally seek out plants from a compatible biome to munch on.[/p][p]They do not gain any food from this behavior to keep Challenge Mode fair, though we'd like to add that as a sandbox option in a later update.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/2eeaea79b97147a5c2ed01ac243beeb6d0f454ef.png"][/img][/p][h2]Feeders & Enrichment[/h2][p]Update 15 introduces [b]new options for the game's standard feeders[/b]. With this release, we've added a small 1m dish, a wide 4m trough and an absolutely massive 6m dish. These all come with updated visuals for both the food and containers themselves, finally adding much-requested support for recoloring your feeders. Oh, and there's a new plastic style, too![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/8b2d13a932233a51f78bb0ba0527efdf0e313dc1.png"][/img][/p][p]Moving onto the enrichment feed, there's quite a lot here! To start, herbivores now have a variety of hay pieces that they can eat. Both hay piles and bales have been provided for players whose paddock either falls into a zoo-vibe or a farm-vibe.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/c568e18b13abc0d8c14bec2680de8fb8bb5e91fe.jpg"][/img][/p][p]In addition to these, a bunch of faux feeders have been added, too. These are artificial containers designed to look like natural elements, providing your animals with a safe but enriching experience.[/p][p]There are faux fish, animal carcasses, logs and stumps. The latter in particular can provide plants, fruit or insects![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/225455856a8437c9921718012a48591218b8ebd6.png"][/img][/p][h2]Animal Nursery[/h2][p]The [b]Animal Nursery menu[/b] has been redesigned for better usability and organisation, providing new sorting methods such as alphabetical, unlocked and by price. There's also a filtering menu to really narrow down your results![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//30171105/7d41f865e9b7e34c7d4b3cf9238c6f5b790e075b.jpg"][/img][/p][p]After selecting an animal, you'll now see a 1:1 recreation of what your animal will look like once it's in the park. From here, players can now randomize the skin, sex or maturity values of their animals.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/a7fb63055837a297697b5cb84f143b8cf30d51d0.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Clicking on the new settings button will allow players to customize their animals further - overriding their mutation or color/size variation. If you've always wanted to make the biggest leucistic T. rex in just a few clicks, now you can![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/ee53cdcf231643237ec08eb3e698cca8444a4c9f.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]Animal Milestones[/h2][p][b]Animal Milestones[/b] are a new mechanic that allow animals to grow with you. As they spend time in the park, they can achieve various goals, rewarding them with more Animal Points.[/p][p]Milestones can range from being born in the park to getting rejected too many times![/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/e0147cf6-8384-4f40-a66a-1b147bf91387/Milestones.png?format=2500w"][/img][/p][h2]Landscaping[/h2][p]The [b]Landscaping menu[/b] has been overhauled with a new vertically scaling design! This adds a bunch of quality of life improvements like being able to see all the plants or terrain textures at once.[/p][p]Players also have access to a variety of brush types when painting ground textures or sculpting terrain, making it easier than ever to create realistic landscapes when combined with the new auto-slope painting features.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//30171105/78e6524cba0b6b40f7612ab887071b23ad426887.jpg"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//30171105/d8d7720088a251f74dedc6ece729b66f90f45144.jpg"][/img][/p][p]You'll note that we've added new grass textures and added other settings like a water mask that stops foliage from being painted in water. For aquatic plants like the Mesozoic nelumbo, they'll even paint directly to the water surface.[/p][p][/p][h2]Global Grid[/h2][p]The [b]global building grid[/b] has been reworked to make it easier than ever to construct organised parks like zoo-sim games of the past. This feature has been expanded to fences, too![/p][p][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//30171105/3b5a4cf6200a6ef24c191bd498d9717d41f1e8e2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Update 15 Changes[/h1][p align="start"][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"][b]CHALLENGE MODE: PROFIT TAX[/b][/p][p align="start"]To address the economy bloat reported by Challenge Mode players during the mid-late game, we’ve introduced profit tax.[/p][p align="start"]At the start of each month, players can earn up to $10,000 tax free. After this, a tax percentage is automatically deducted from their income, scaling with higher earnings. Your profit tax resets each month and can be seen in the Finances menu under the quarterly profit. A tooltip reveals more information about the various tax brackets.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]CHALLENGE MODE: EXCAVATION EVENTS[/b][/p][p align="start"]Positive Excavation events now last for two months, allowing players to better take advantage of their benefits. The amount of negative events per month have also been decreased.[/p][p align="start"]This coincides with a general rebalancing of excavations as well as the inclusion of paleobotany sites.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]CHALLENGE MODE: RESEARCH ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/p][p align="start"]A number of research items have been added, changed or removed to improve the game’s progression.[/p][p align="start"][/p][p align="start"][b]ENCLOSURE ANIMAL LIST[/b][/p][p align="start"]An animal list has been added to the enclosure menu, allowing players to quickly see all the contained animals and filter by species.[/p][p][/p][h3]Coming Soon: Update 15.1[/h3][p align="start"][img src="https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images//30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][p align="start"]Although this is not how we planned to ship Update 15, unfortunate circumstances over the last few weeks have meant that we have elected to prioritise the wellbeing of our team members and focus on the core breeding mechanics. [/p][p align="start"]These: features will be arriving in a second update coming in September:[/p][list][*][p]Animal Head IK[/p][/*][*][p]Interspecies threat displays and fleeing (however this CAN occur during courtship right now!)[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We apologise and hope you can respect our decision on this. The team currently expects Update 15.1 to arrive before the end of September - only a few weeks away.[/p][p][/p][h3]Known Issues & Additional Notes[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Some dig and threaten animations are currently missing audio[/p][/*][*][p]We want to adapt the starting facilities in new games to fit the new global grid in a future update[/p][/*][*][p]Undo/redo for terrain sculpting with automatic slope painting attached isn't fully hooked up yet[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][h2]Features[/h2][p] [/p][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 22 paleobotany excavation sites: [/p][list][*][p]North America:[/p][list][*][p]Colorado Flats[/p][/*][*][p]Eagle Sandstone[/p][/*][*][p]Edmonton Shale[/p][/*][*][p]Kansas Rocks[/p][/*][*][p]Montana Hills[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]South America:[/p][list][*][p]Araripe Basin[/p][/*][*][p]Chubut Conglomerate[/p][/*][*][p]Deseado Massif[/p][/*][*][p]San Luis Siltstone[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Europe:[/p][list][*][p]Bavarian Lithic Reef[/p][/*][*][p]Bohemian Massif[/p][/*][*][p]Lusitanian Rift[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Asia:[/p][list][*][p]Bartala Hill[/p][/*][*][p]Gobi Badlands[/p][/*][*][p]Henan Deposits[/p][/*][*][p]Honshu Group[/p][/*][*][p]Korean Shale[/p][/*][*][p]Wuyun Clays[/p][/*][*][p]Yanliao Sediments[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Africa[/p][list][*][p]Cape Sandstones[/p][/*][*][p]Maghrebian Desert Beds[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Antarctica[/p][list][*][p]Antarctic Highlands[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Added new Research progression items:[/p][list][*][p]Biology[/p][list][*][p][b]Chromatic Phenotype Selection

 [b]Balance[/b][/p][list][*][p]Progression:[/p][list][*][p]Rebalanced animal points and attraction points rating goals[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted fossil DNA yield during excavations, so that higher rated animals take longer to fully excavate[/p][/*][*][p]Excavation events are now reset when an excavation site becomes fully researched[/p][/*][*][p]Positive excavation events now have a minimum duration period of 2 months, making for a longer lasting reward[/p][/*][*][p]Additional Loading Bays now start out as empty of stock when placed, duplicated, or split[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Economy & Logistics:[/p][list][*][p]Doubled the cost for research and excavations[/p][/*][*][p]All fencing now has upkeep costs that are paid at the end of each game month[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced [b]Profit Tax[/b], a bracket system that taxes park income based on current monthly profit. The profit tax read out is accessible by hovering over the profit header in the Finances Summary[/p][/*][*][p]Landscaping operations now cost money based on the actions’ weight. Park balance is now actively affected by terraforming costs[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced max donation amounts for all Donation Boxes[/p][/*][*][p]Increased purchase and upkeep costs for Loading Bay trucks[/p][/*][*][p]Shortened Loading Bay import times[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased Loading Bay import amount[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased loan pay back times across the board[/p][/*][*][p]High-rated loans are now inaccessible if park rating falls down below their respective threshold[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Animals:[/p][list][*][p]Different animal growth speeds now impact incubation costs for all animals, the slower the growth speed, the higher the incubation cost, and viceversaIncreased facility upkeep costs across the board[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Guests:[/p][list][*][p]Slowed down guest need draining considerably, allowing their AI to prioritize exploration and animal viewing over constant need fulfillment[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]Research progression gameplay:[/p][list][*][p]Re-arranged certain research items to fit the newly added trees[/p][/*][*][p]Removed obsolete research items[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Landscaping gameplay:[/p][list][*][p]Terrain sculpting and terrain painting now feature brush selection, allowing players to pick from individual libraries of brushes for each action. This drastically expands sculpting and painting options, leading to more natural looking custom environments[/p][/*][*][p]Water-floating plants will now automatically stick to the water’s surface when painted using the foliage brush, retaining their relative position to the water with any terrain change. If no water volume is readily available at their position, these plant items will stick to the terrain like normal[/p][/*][*][p]By default, fully aquatic plants will paint on water bodies only, while fully terrestrial plants will be masked out by water. This effect can be turned off through the ‘Respect Water Mask’ toggle in the new Landscaping GUI[/p][/*][*][p]The foliage brush has been majorly overhauled, with new internal density rules allowing for much more naturalistic environments at any brush size or intensity[/p][/*][*][p]The Landscaping Brush intensity/size can now be changed by holding Ctrl/Shift and using the mouse scroll construction[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Animals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated animal diets[/p][list][*][p]Piscivore diet added to Coelophysis, Velociraptor[/p][/*][*][p]Insectivore diet added to Deinocheirus, [b]Crashes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a major crash triggered by selecting an animal in the Animal Nursery[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed improper memory management that could lead to crashes around animal deletion[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Critical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Addressed potentially critical animal age processing oversight, which could have been causing inconsistent aging speeds for animal individuals[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple critical navigation errors resulting in animal teleportation, which should hopefully be much less common now![/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a Special Exhibit-related data desync causing in-game animal and species counter to report incorrect numbers[/p][/*][*][p]Placing animals no longer triggers building music[/p][/*][*][p]Closing the building toolbox will cause music to lower in intensity, but can pick up again if the player opens the building toolbox soon after[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a critical issue related to Research Unlock progression, generally consolidating the entire research system[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed many discrepancies with undo/redo refund logic, which should be much more sound and less abusable now[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the new game starting prefabs [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/043435e2a5544512f89f43571a7ecf3a21c794c7.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/ad3d23456b2e8789dda075e135d6ee1b51984308.png"][/img]Welcome, [b]Park Testers[/b]!  [/p][p][/p][p]This PTB release targets a number of balance measures for animal breeding, which should now work more reliably, provide more information, and bug out less frequently. As always, general stability has been improved with a round of bug fixing.[/p][p][/p][h3]How to Access the Public Testing Branch (Experimental!)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img]The Public Testing Branch (PTB) is a version of Prehistoric Kingdom that can be opted-into on Steam, containing experimental and potentially breaking changes. With the help of the community, we're able to hunt down various issues and gather feedback before pushing a an update to the public version of Prehistoric Kingdom. 
[/p][olist][*][p] Right click Prehistoric Kingdom in your Steam Library
[/p][/*][*][p] Go to Properties
[/p][/*][*][p] Betas
[/p][/*][*][p] Select 'ptb_public_testing'[/p][/*][/olist][p]Please note that [b]it is not recommended to play Public Testing Branch parks on earlier versions of the game.[/b] Please send feedback and bug reports to our [url="https://discord.com/invite/pkgame"]Discord server's[/url] appropriate channel.

[/p][h3]Known Issues & Additional Notes[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Undo/redo for terrain sculpting with automatic slope painting attached isn't fully hooked up yet,[/p][/*][*][p]Animal drinking points need a review, as animals can pick wildly inconsistent drinking points,[/p][/*][*][p]Various sound effects for new animations have not been hooked up yet,[/p][/*][*][p]There are a number of temporary or missing icons for the paleobotany paleopedia entries[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][h2]Additions[/h2][p]
 [b]Animals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added new additive and action animations to Gallimimus[/p][/*][*][p]Added courtship animations to:[/p][list][*][p]Argentinosaurus[/p][/*][*][p]Brachiosaurus[/p][/*][*][p]Megaloceros[/p][/*][*][p]Tyrannosaurus/Tarbosaurus[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]UI/UX[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added staff cycling buttons in the Staff Info menu, allowing to quickly select different staff members[/p][/*][*][p]Added a 'Breeding Space' indicator in the Animal Biology tab in the Animal Info menu, displaying whether an animal has enough space in its exhibit to breed[/p][/*][*][p]Added Leader icon to the Animal Tooltip header[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Gates snapping to fences now play a snapping sound relative to the fence’s material[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][p][/p][p]  [b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]Grid fence placement is now ignored during Fence Replacement previously built segment[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Animals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusting animal breeding parameters[/p][list][*][p]Reduced sauropod clutch sizes[/p][/*][*][p]Doubled oviparous animal total incubation times[/p][/*][*][p]Animals will now require their overall welfare above a certain threshold to be interested in mating[/p][/*][*][p]Clutch sizes will now have random variation capped by the fertility of the parents[/p][/*][*][p]Increased embryo count for both Torvosaurus species[/p][/*][*][p]Increased embryo survival chances for Acrocanthosaurus and mating rejection reactions[/p][/*][*][p]Slowed down animal maturing speed across the board[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Buildings & Scenery[/b][/p][list][*][p]Updated colliders for natural branches and logs to fix long-standing error spam[/p][/*][*][p]Scaling constraints for Animal Information Screen have been fixed[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Foliage[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved surface adherence for ground foliage[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]UI/UX[/b][/p][list][*][p]The breeding season indicator graphic in the Animal Info menu now displays whether an animal has been rejected during the current breeding season[/p][/*][*][p]Gates now automatically generate their own individual groups upon placement[/p][/*][*][p]Opening the management menu now clears outstanding user actions[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked logic for the main menu's 'Continue Button' behavior, which now more accurately picks the last saved game, and properly refreshes when saves are deleted[/p][/*][*][p]'Replace Fence Mode' and 'Replace Path the building toolbox will cause music to lower in intensity, but can pick up again if the player opens the building toolbox soon after[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][p][/p][p]  [b]Critical[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed animal maturing speed desync, which was applying an additional time scale multiplier. Aging speed is now consistent to the reported paleopedia values[/p][/*][*][p]Population Explosion from nests should be fixed[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed critical guest issues related to invalid navmeshes[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed animal info signs not initializing guest interactability, which would result in info signs not registering attraction points, or not being recognized by guests as education modules[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed underground ghost foliage in the Parque Nacional Arenal map[/p][/*][*][p]Added various safety guards against crashes related to animals[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed mis-timed code in human AI shutdown that could’ve led to memory corruption[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed staff GUI exceptions caused by threaded code[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Loading Bays not having resources available at new game start[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Animals[/b][/p][list][*][p]Animal AI States now have a timeout, this should fix animals getting stuck vocalizing and never completing socialization need fulfillment[/p][/*][*][p]Animals can no longer perform their mating display while swimming[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed animals being considered “wading” when there was no water, preventing egg laying and nest management[/p][/*][*][p]Animals should no longer try to mate when they have already mated for the season[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]Guests[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed a bug that could stall the human AI[/p][/*][/list][p] [b]UI/UX[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed nursery skin selection being interactable even if the relevant research isn’t unlocked[/p][/*][*][p]Updated paleopedia animal maturity read-outs to report on animal breeding maturity, instead of total maturity[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the breeding indicator graphic to include an 'Immature' label for sexually immature animals[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the 'Click to research' element in the foliage tooltip to be based on a different check than the rest of the foliage unlock gui[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed staff task icon discrepancy between the Staff Management menu and the Staff Info menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the 'Curved Placement Mode' toggle in the fence action GUI not updating the currently placing fence segment[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed parents social interaction needs bar for infant animals in the Animal Info menu[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed foliage preset gui unlock events[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p]This release addresses some of the main stability concerns, greatly improving session lifetime performance, while also giving our most avid builders brand new nature items.  [/p][p]As always, a swathe of bugs and glitches have been targeted thanks to everyone's invaluable feedback![/p][p][/p][h3]How to Access the Public Testing Branch (Experimental!)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img]The Public Testing Branch (PTB) is a version of Prehistoric Kingdom that can be opted-into on Steam, containing experimental and potentially breaking changes. With the help of the community, we're able to hunt down various issues and gather feedback before pushing a an update to the public version of Prehistoric Kingdom. 

 Right click Prehistoric Kingdom in your Steam Library
 Go to Properties
 Betas
 Select 'ptb_public_testing'Please note that [b]it is not recommended to play Public Testing Branch parks on earlier versions of the game.[/b] Please send feedback and bug reports to our [url="https://discord.com/invite/pkgame"]Discord server's[/url] appropriate channel.

notes.title: PTB: Update 15 Begins Testing!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/12f6dad9e292cbf2c0a972453b19388b4a6305f7.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/ad3d23456b2e8789dda075e135d6ee1b51984308.png"][/img][/p][p]Welcome, [b]Park Testers[/b]!  [/p][p]This early version of Update 15 includes breeding, paleobotany, improved landscaping, new feeders and a variety of other changes. We are expecting to launch this update on August 25.  While the update remains a work in progress, we are looking for feedback in these areas:[/p][list][*][p]Challenge Mode balance[/p][list][*][p]Financial difficulty[/p][/*][*][p]Research tree experience[/p][/*][*][p]Animal poop frequency and compost conversion[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Breeding frequency and reliability[/p][/*][/list][p]As mentioned there have been a lot of changes since the last update, so be sure to read the full patch notes below to see everything that's new![/p][p][/p][h3]PTB Features[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][p]The headlining feature for this update is [b]breeding[/b]! Throughout the year, animals experience a breeding season that allows them to partake in courtship, reproduce and maintain a nest or birthing bed built by the player.[/p][p]To maximise the amount of offspring an animal can have, players can create animals with high fertility from the Animal Nursery. Creating creatures from a young maturity at slower growth speeds yields the best result once they reach sexual maturity.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/1b0ffbfe-fa00-4925-abac-12f7fc30c1de/RexNest.png?format=2500w"][/img][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/d58d5143-6561-4923-b8fb-55256cae895e/NestVariationBear.png?format=2500w"][/img][/p][p][b]Gallimimus[/b] also hits the PTB with all three skins and its ontogeny ready to go! Players can excavate this animal from the Nemegt Formation or grab it immediately in Sandbox Mode.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/850fb535a2f0c550fd44c5ccc046882045dbcf32.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Paleobotany[/b] is a big inclusion for Update 15, adding over 200 plant variations across 30+ species of Mesozoic flora. In Challenge Mode, players can unlock paleobotany via the Fossil Depot, excavating them just like animals. [/p][p]In terms of gameplay, a new [b]Mesozoic[/b] or [b]Cenozoic[/b] flora bar has been added to the animal habitat and enrichment panels. This bar will fill up as era-appropriate foliage is added to their enclosure, providing additional animal points. We plan to add more benefits later down the line![/p][p]Note that providing era-appropriate foliage is not a hard requirement and simply a reward for players who want to go the extra mile![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/2e5ecf35912fcc827c6e175c6b9d7bbcb38bc6b5.png"][/img][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/8f165f31-ea35-4be0-818d-53d43ef55b99/PaleoScrubland1.jpg?format=2500w"][/img][/p][p][b]Landscaping[/b] has seen massive updates with a new interface, terrain brushes, new grass masking rules, reworked foliage densities and auto-slope painting.[/p][p]The new UI can be vertically scaled to show more or less depending on what the player wants, while new options such as a water mask when painting plants has been added too. [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/78e6524cba0b6b40f7612ab887071b23ad426887.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/d8d7720088a251f74dedc6ece729b66f90f45144.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Similarly, the enhanced [b]global building grid[/b] makes it easier than ever to construct organised parks like zoo-sim games of the past. This feature has been expanded to fences, too![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/3b5a4cf6200a6ef24c191bd498d9717d41f1e8e2.png"][/img][/p][p]Shifting back to animals, the reworked [b]Animal Nursery menu[/b] provides a more intuitive layout with a myriad of settings to organise your animal list exactly how you want. [/p][p]Selecting an animal reveals basic information as well as new options for randomization and skin customization. The preview itself is now entirely accurate to the individual specimen you're about to create, too![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/7d41f865e9b7e34c7d4b3cf9238c6f5b790e075b.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/7b92971ba5d3312cd44c26f206f61128365383c5.jpg"][/img][/p][p][b]Animal Milestones[/b] are a new mechanic that allow animals to grow with you. As they spend time in the park, they can achieve various goals, rewarding them with Animal Points.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/e0147cf6-8384-4f40-a66a-1b147bf91387/Milestones.png?format=2500w"][/img][/p][p]Finally, a variety of [b]new feeder sizes[/b] (1m, 4m trough, 6m) and a new plastic style have been added to the basic food trays. Additional enrichment feeders such as hay piles, hay bales and faux fish carcasses have been included too. Finally, your tiny animals don't need to eat from massive trays![/p][p]We hope to get a couple more of these in by the full release of Update 15.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/feec6f6f0fc2beab82ad8ff0bc63abd5644aa6b5.jpg"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/c568e18b13abc0d8c14bec2680de8fb8bb5e91fe.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]PTB Changes[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][p][b]CHALLENGE MODE: PROFIT TAX[/b][/p][p]To address the economy bloat reported by Challenge Mode players during the mid-late game, we’ve introduced profit tax. [/p][p]At the start of each month, players can earn up to $10,000 tax free. After this, a tax percentage is automatically deducted from their income, scaling with higher earnings. Your profit tax resets each month and can be seen in the Finances menu under the quarterly profit. A tooltip reveals more information about the various tax brackets.[/p][p][/p][p][b]CHALLENGE MODE: EXCAVATION EVENTS[/b][/p][p]Positive Excavation events now last for two months, allowing players to better take advantage of their benefits. The amount of negative events per month have also been decreased.[/p][p]This coincides with a general rebalancing of excavations as well as the inclusion of paleobotany sites.[/p][p][/p][p][b]CHALLENGE MODE: RESEARCH ADJUSTMENTS[/b][/p][p]A number of research items have been added, changed or removed to improve the game’s progression.[/p][p][/p][p][b]ENCLOSURE ANIMAL LIST[/b][/p][p]An animal list has been added to the enclosure menu, allowing players to quickly see all the contained animals and filter by species.[/p][p][/p][h3]What is NOT included in this PTB?[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][p]As usual, we are still working to add the remaining features, audio and other components that'll be there when the update fully releases. While the game is playable, you can expect to run into bugs, crashes or general oddities. Please send your feedback and bug reports to our [url="https://discord.com/invite/pkgame"]Discord server's[/url] appropriate channel.[/p][p]Here are the major outstanding things not present in the PTB:[/p][list][*][p]Threaten system[/p][/*][*][p]Animal Head IK[/p][/*][*][p]Animals browsing from foliage[/p][/*][*][p]Animal feeder diversity need[/p][/*][*][p]Expanded tutorials and adjustments to make them more detailed[/p][/*][*][p]Oviraptor[/p][/*][/list][p]Though we are on track for most of this to make it into the final release, we are likely going to have to follow up with an Update 15.1 to truly flesh it out. [/p][p]Head IK has taken much longer than we anticipated to come online, leaving the planned threaten behaviors less developed than what we’d like.[/p][p][/p][h3]How to Access the Public Testing Branch (Experimental!)[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img]The Public Testing Branch (PTB) is a version of Prehistoric Kingdom that can be opted-into on Steam, containing experimental and potentially breaking changes. With the help of the community, we're able to hunt down various issues and gather feedback before pushing a an update to the public version of Prehistoric Kingdom.    Right click Prehistoric Kingdom in your Steam Library  Go to Properties  Betas  Select 'ptb_public_testing'Please note that [b]it is not recommended to play Public Testing Branch parks on earlier versions of the game.[/b] Please send feedback and bug reports to our [url="https://discord.com/invite/pkgame"]Discord server's[/url] appropriate channel.  [/p][p][/p][h3]Known Issues & Additional Notes[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Undo/redo for terrain sculpting with automatic slope painting attached isn't fully hooked up yet,[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Animals socialization needs frequency balancing, and currently the socialization need can remain low for a long time,[/p][/*][*][p]Animal drinking points need a review, as animals can pick wildly inconsistent drinking points,[/p][/*][*][p]Some players may experience severe FPS drops when opening the Animal Management Menu, we're actively working on a fix for this[/p][/*][*][p]Various sound effects for new animations have not been hooked up yet[/p][/*][*][p]There are a number of temporary or missing icons for research and paleobotany paleopedia entries[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][h2]Features[/h2][list][*][p][b]NEW ANIMAL: Gallimimus bullatus[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW FEATURE: Animal Courtship & Breeding
[/b]During the breeding season, male animals will attempt to court females and create their next generation. After successful courtship, females will try to look for a nest or birthing bed built by the player in order to build, manage and guard it. [/p][p][/p][p]Following a pregnancy period, animals will either lay eggs or give birth at their respective modules. The behavior seen throughout the breeding process is variable depending on the species, leading to parents that may abandon their nest or species where parents work together to maintain it.[/p][p][/p][p]If parents wander too far away to find food or water, they have a greater chance of losing their offspring.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW FEATURE: Paleobotany
[/b]An array of Mesozoic paleobotany can be excavated around the world by dig teams. Placing era-appropriate foliage into habitats will reward animals with enrichment and additional Animal Points, making them worth more.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW FEATURE: Animal Milestones
[/b]Animal Milestones are a new mechanic that allow animals to grow with you. As they spend time in the park, they can achieve various goals, rewarding them with Animal Points.[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CHANGE: Overhauled Global Grid [/b]The global construction grid has been given many visual and mechanical improvements! Any modular group can now be fully fitted to the global grid, allowing players to perfectly align facilities across the park. This feature also applied to fence placement, which can now stick to the grid tiles’ outer edges[/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CHANGE: Landscaping Menu[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]NEW CHANGE: Animal Nursery Menu [/b]The animal nursery has a new layout for easier navigation! Sort by unlocked, alphabetical, price, rating, type and clade to find an animal at a glance. Adjust the new filtering options to get a granular look at specific animals in your collection.[b] [/b] The animal preview is now accurate to what will be created, featuring the new randomize buttons, overridable mutations and adjust variation for skins and sizes![/p][/*][/list][h2]Additions[/h2][list][*][p][b]Gameplay[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added 22 paleobotany excavation sites: [/p][list][*][p]North America:[/p][list][*][p]Colorado Flats[/p][/*][*][p]Eagle Sandstone[/p][/*][*][p]Edmonton Shale[/p][/*][*][p]Kansas Rocks[/p][/*][*][p]Montana Hills[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]South America:[/p][list][*][p]Araripe Basin[/p][/*][*][p]Chubut Conglomerate[/p][/*][*][p]Deseado Massif[/p][/*][*][p]San Luis Siltstone[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Europe:[/p][list][*][p]Bavarian Lithic Reef[/p][/*][*][p]Bohemian Massif[/p][/*][*][p]Lusitanian Rift[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Asia:[/p][list][*][p]Bartala Hill[/p][/*][*][p]Gobi Badlands[/p][/*][*][p]Henan Deposits[/p][/*][*][p]Honshu Group[/p][/*][*][p]Korean Shale[/p][/*][*][p]Wuyun Clays[/p][/*][*][p]Yanliao Sediments[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Africa[/p][list][*][p]Cape Sandstones[/p][/*][*][p]Maghrebian Desert Beds[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Antarctica[/p][list][*][p]Antarctic Highlands[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][list][*][p]Added new Research progression items:[/p][list][*][p]Biology[/p][list][*][p][b]Chromatic Phenotype Selection [/b]Enables picking specific skins for animals in the Nursery[/p][/*][*][p][b]Chromatic Expression Modulation [/b]Enables editing an animal’s mutations and coloration in the Nursery[/p][/*][*][p][b]Somatic Growth Modulation [/b]Enables size editing for animals in the Nursery[/p][/*][*][p][b]High-Capacity Low Feeders[/b] Unlocks feeders suitable for feeding larger animals[/p][/*][*][p][b]High-Capacity Tall Feeders[/b] Unlocks feeders suitable for feeding large or tall animals[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New Research Tree: Management[/p][list][*][p][b]Higher Education [/b]Speeds up Staff skill learning in the Staff Center[/p][/*][*][p][b]Produce Station Plants [/b]Unlocks the Produce Station Plants, allowing for the local production of herbivore feed[/p][/*][*][p][b]Produce Station Fruit [/b]Unlocks the Produce Station Fruit, allowing for the local production of frugivore feed[/p][/*][*][p][b]Produce Station Meat [/b]Unlocks the Produce Station Meat, allowing for the local production of carnivore feed[/p][/*][*][p][b]Produce Station Fish [/b]Unlocks the Produce Station Fish, allowing for the local production notes.title: Update 15 arriving August 25!
notes.notes:
[previewyoutube="6O64evED-mI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][b]Update 15[/b] is coming this month on [b]August 25[/b]!

An early version of this release will be available on the Public Testing Branch starting [b]August 11[/b], allowing the team to gather bug reports while we continue working on the remaining features and content for Update 15.
[/p][h2]New Animals[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/3fc5d970-75e8-4d4f-be7c-b762063dff0b/GallimimusEnviro.png?format=2500w"][/img][/p][p]Joining the roster in Update 15 are two feathered dinosaurs from the Cretaceous: Gallimimus and Oviraptor! Like other species, these animals come with seamless ontogeny cycles, allowing them to grow from baby to adult.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/07641526-cf0f-4da4-8ddf-88462f12299d/Oviraptor_Nest.png?format=2500w"][/img][/p][h2]Breeding & Courtship[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][p]Throughout the year, each species will have its own breeding season! Provide nests for dinosaurs and birthing beds for mammals to let them naturally reproduce.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/6941532f-5711-40ba-8ecb-ad02dcdd1e0c/NestHero.png?format=2500w"][/img][/p][p]After successful courtship, animals will look for a nest to build, maintain and guard to varying degrees depending on the species. If the parents stray too far, it's even possible for their unborn offspring to perish. Don't make them walk too far for food and water![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/0ad16f1b-88b8-4d82-b497-3eb60e2b9ce9/NestVariationVelo.png?format=2500w"][/img][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/d58d5143-6561-4923-b8fb-55256cae895e/NestVariationBear.png?format=2500w"][/img][/p][h2]Paleobotany[/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][p]Excavate and discover over 30 species of Mesozoic flora across 8 biomes with Paleobotany! Send teams out around the world to bring back 200+ individual plant variations for your dinosaur habitats.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/8f165f31-ea35-4be0-818d-53d43ef55b99/PaleoScrubland1.jpg?format=2500w"][/img][/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/731d1765-158f-447a-9177-48ff152518ab/DiaryJune2025_PaleoEnvironment_Wetland_1.png?format=2500w"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]For both dinosaurs and mammals, placing era-appropriate plants in your habitats will allow them to gain rewards such as bonus animal points![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/a626cd82-848e-40e2-8875-c3eab3e96eb2/DiaryJune2025_PaleoEnvironment_Wetland_2.png?format=2500w"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]And More![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img][/p][p][b]ANIMAL MILESTONES[/b][/p][p]Throughout their life, animals can achieve various goals to improve their perception in the park. This can include things like being born naturally, growing up in the park and becoming the alpha of a herd.[/p][p][/p][p][b]ANIMAL NURSERY OVERHAUL[/b][/p][p]Breed animals in the updated Animal Nursery menu, boasting improved layouts and functionality with features like random skin selection, skin editing and genetic mutation overrides. [/p][p][/p][p][b]ANIMAL FEEDERS[/b][/p][p]Add a variety of new feeders to your exhibit with additional sizes (1m, 4m trough, 6m), a new plastic style and additional enrichment feeders such as hay piles and hay bales. Finally, your tiny animals don't need to eat from massive trays![/p][p][/p][p][b]LANDSCAPING IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/p][p]Easily create the habitat of your dreams with a reworked landscaping menu and features. Auto-paint terrain slopes or try out our suite of new brush textures to quickly add detailed substrate.[/p][p][/p][p][b]IMPROVED GLOBAL BUILDING GRID[/b][/p][p]Build highly organised zoos with a reworked global building grid, making it easier than ever to construct symmetrical or evenly spaced areas across the park. This feature has been extended to fences, too![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png"][/img] [/p][p]The full patch notes will be available once the update goes live. 

See you soon, park managers!

We expect that this will likely be the last support patch before the team moves onto full production for Update 15 with its expected release in July. We're aiming for the first PTB to start in late June. Please check out future Dev Diaries for more updates!

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png[/img]

[*] [b]Rendering[/b][list]
[*] Added Screen Space Global Illumination to the game, helping to light shaded areas more realistically. Its quality can be set in the ‘Indirect Lighting’ setting in the Options Menu[/list][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list]
[*] [b]Animals[/b][list]
[*] Animals will now only engage in the Play Chase behavior when near the group destination, so they don’t get distracted when the group is moving[/list][*] [b]Staff[/b][list]
[*] Reduced max staff count to 2048[/list][*] [b]UI/UX[/b][list]
[*] The ‘Social’ group tab is now disabled for baby animals, since they can’t form social groups. Instead, the ‘Family’ tab is selected by default for them
[*] Upgraded the save/load menu to use the same layout and visual style as the rest of the game’s GUI[/list][*] [b]Environment[/b][list]
[*] Updated wetland grass texture to feature a mix of soil and grass[/list][*] [b]Foliage[/b][list]
[*] Adjusted Field Elm coloration
[*] Adjusted Marula coloration[/list][/list][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list]
[*] [b]Crashes[/b][list]
[*] Fixed animals caching references to animals which had been sold or otherwise invalidated, which could have caused crashes[/list][*] [b]Animals[/b][list]
[*] Fixed animals getting stuck on corners, and reduced false negatives in nav adherence checks that were contributing to animal teleports
[*] Fixed baby animals filling their nutrition and hydration bars at super speed
[*] Fixed a logical error that was preventing animals from validating their roam destinations relative to the group destination, causing animals to roam far and wide regardless of the group[/list][*] [b]Staff[/b][list]
[*] Staff gates will now keep better track of who is walking through them, including the first person character controller, and should not remain open anymore[/list][*] [b]UI/UX[/b][list]
[*] Fixed the Nursery animal preview animations being stuck on a glitchy loop - animals should be back to playing their fidget animations, with babies having a chance of playing their specific baby animation too
[*] Fixed a small oversight causing animal exhibit preference bars to not produce a tooltip on hover[/list][/list][h2]Performance[/h2][list]
[*] Fixed memory leaks in vegetation tracking
[*] Environmental reflections are now baked for each time of day and weather combo, reducing the stutter and potential performance degradation from the real time probe used previously[/list]

notes.title: Prehistoric Kingdom - Update 14 (1.14.39)
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/56b088687aa1bb040c11b2bcf396f39055ec5112.png[/img]

Welcome, [b]Park Managers[/b], to Update 14!

This monumental release adds the highly anticipated ontogeny system to Prehistoric Kingdom, unleashing seamless growth for over 50 species. Get up close and personal with the all new first person mode, or watch your animals create families and social bonds from a distance.

If you'd like to support us, [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/666150/Prehistoric_Kingdom/]the game is currently 30% off[/url] AND we've [url=https://youtooz.com/products/crowny-plush-1ft]just launched a YouTooz plush! The plushie will be available from 3PM EST while stocks last, so be sure to order quick![/url]

[previewyoutube=4qv_QxjI3X4;full][/previewyoutube]
[url=https://youtooz.com/products/crowny-plush-1ft][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/64cd9b200741a0ac1af76a04b6b7f3e336de35ff.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Update 14 Content[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png[/img]
[h2]Baby Animals and Ontogeny[/h2]
As a genre-breaking first, Prehistoric Kingdom now features seamless ontogeny, allowing players to watch their animals grow from baby to adult without model swaps or immersion-breaking size jumps. 

These aren't just scaled down adults, however! Every species changes its physical proportions, skin, sounds and body features over the course of our realtime maturity simulation. This was an enormous task, but the team is extremely proud of what we were able to pull off despite our size.

[b]Ontogeny is available for every species in the game[/b] apart from terrarium species like Archaeopteryx and Microraptor. And remember, this is just the beginning! We look forward to adding more baby animations and sounds in future updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/d10dfc956f493fdf31d0ad68439c8067979c17bd.jpg[/img]
[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/2a12db7c-af16-4c0f-84e7-bd04a2d0e843/U14_Sinotherium.png?format=2500w[/img]
[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/bcb0b94c-f69b-431a-833e-826f5ee19ffb/U14_Velo.jpg?format=2500w[/img]

So, how does it work? From the Animal Nursery, there are now two sliders: ontogeny and neoteny. Ontogeny determines the maturity than an animal starts at, while neoteny is the maximum maturity it will grow to. This allows players to keep their babies as babies forever, or even stunt growth to simulate animals not in the game like Nanotyrannus. 

Players can also set their desired growth speed for newly bred animals: fast, normal, slow or realistic. We think realistic is pretty fun, as beyond being more accurate, we've found ourselves getting even more attached to animals as they grow.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PIggPJX.png[/img]

You can find new tooltips in the Paleopedia that tell you how long it'll take for an animal to reach adulthood depending on your desired growth speed.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PsFCRoT.png[/img]

[h2]Animal Herding, Socialisation Behaviors and Families[/h2]
In Update 14, animals will now form social groups! Depending on the species, they’ll follow their group leader and synchronize behavior (eating, drinking, resting, etc.) to varying degrees. Some animals like Dryosaurus are super tight knit, while an Acrocanthosaurus is completely solitary.

If a social group is incomplete and needs more animals to be happy, the group leader will broadcast, making it clear they're looking for friends.

[img]https://images.squarespace-cdn.com/content/v1/5f5169d31c810e0faa346016/bef17003-7e64-4267-bef8-30f04fe18849/Herding_Banner.jpg?format=2500w[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OZOniak.png[/img]

Animals will now properly socialise, too, driven by their new awareness system. This means that if they can hear or see each other without objects or solid fences in the way, they'll initiate a call and response to improve their social welfare. Typically this is more common for animals within the same social group, but there's a small chance for socialisation to occur across multiple species.

As an extension of this, animals that are suffering from poor welfare conditions will use sad and angry calls to make it clear that they're unhappy!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/emKBYRJ.png[/img]

Excitingly, babies have some extra behaviors as well. Infants can be adopted by adult animals, though they won’t contribute to a social group until reaching adolescence. If infants cannot find an adult, however, they’ll stick together regardless depending on the species.

Babies also have a high chance of performing the [b]play chase behavior[/b], making two animals chase each other around a circular area. This behavior can also be observed in a few adult species, such as Coelophysis, Dryosaurus, Juxia, Leaellynasaura, Nasutoceratops, Ouranosaurus, Protoceratops, Psittacosaurus (all), Scelidosaurus, Ugrunaaluk and Velociraptor.

Be sure to check the Paleopedia to see what animals form social groups or families!

[h2]First Person Mode[/h2]
Get ready to meet and greet your animals in First Person Mode! Accessible from the bottom right of the main HUD, this mode allows you to jump down to ground level as a human. Players are able to run, jump, crouch and even interact with specific modules such as binoculars, gates and benches.

We've also included a few settings in the options menu like FOV and disabling first person music filtering.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/G2gxgMm.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ySlM4sc.png[/img]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Yyn0UIb.png[/img]

[h1]Update 14 Changes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png[/img]
[h3]Animal Incubation, Costs and Mass[/h3]
Animal incubation is now asynchronous, meaning creation will no longer be queued. In Challenge Mode, players will need to research additional slots to breed more animals simultaneously. Similarly, the cost of animal incubation has greatly increased due to the addition of ontogeny. Adult animals are now extremely expensive without the required research to bring them down.

Stats like the base rating and cost of an animal is now based on an animal's mass instead of vibes, creating a more organic and honest economy.

[h3]Animal Crowding[/h3]
We've fixed an oversight pertaining to animal crowding, so habitats that previously housed lots of animals should more accurately report their fullness.

[h3]Feeders and Tall Animals[/h3]
Tall animals such as sauropods and the Paraceratherium can now eat from ground feeders, though will prefer to use tall feeders. This change was made to accomodate baby animals which cannot reach tall feeders.

[h3]Selling Multiple Animals[/h3]
From the animal management menu in Park Services, players can now sell multiple animals at once. Selling an animal from anywhere in the game will also display a confirmation prompt with the potential income.

[h3]Excavations[/h3]
Species such as Edmontosaurus and various mammals can now be found in multiple dig sites. Increasing the funding for a dig site will also now improve the yield, making it quicker to get species with more money. As a side note, science teams are now unlocked automatically with each park rating.

[h3]Guest Spawning[/h3]
Guests will now spawn and use only one contiguous park area, whichever is largest. Players can still put down multiple entrances/guest spawners, but only those which are connected to the largest area will be valid.

Previously it was possible to create multiple disconnected sections of a park, and guests would become confused trying to navigate to attractions in another area. This change affects module accessibility, the visitor navmesh preview, and the visitor areas used for Park Beauty calculation.

[h3]Animal Debug Tool[/h3]
Want to see what animals are thinking? Or maybe you want to report an animal issue? Look no further than the animal debug tool, accessible by pressing Shift + B when an animal has been selected. We plan to keep this is in for a while to help players communicate any problems they've encountered.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/T5aJCUe.png[/img]

[h3]Known Issues & Additional Notes[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png[/img][list]
[*] Issue: modular lighting is not recolorable during the day, but does work at night
[*] Issue: animal avoidance is currently broken, so animals can end up walking through each other
[*] Issue: animal animations in the Animal Nursery are currently broken due to the addition of babies, we will be fixing this
[*] Note: additive animations can trigger during one shots or right before animals go to eat/drink/rest. We would like to stop this from happening to prevent jank
[*] Note: we will be updating Paleopedia and Info Sign screenshots for animals that have received visual updates in a later patch[/list]

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png[/img]
[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*] [b]NEW FEATURE: SEAMLESS ANIMAL ONTOGENY[/b]
Animals can now be incubated in the Animal Nursery at any point in their ontogeny (growth cycle), and seamlessly grow into adulthood. Incubation gameplay has been re-balanced to make adult animals less economically viable in the early game.

Throughout their growth, animals change in real time:
[list]
[*] [b]Proportions[/b] - younger animals are usually lankier, sporting larger extremities and facial features in rapport to the body
[*] [b]Skin & Coloration[/b] - all the baby animals have different patterning and colorations when young, gradually transitioning those into their adult colors. Some babies, like most theropods, are feathered even if the adults aren’t!
[*] [b]Animations[/b] - young animals move around differently, using their own bespoke locomotion animations. Most species even have specific play actions
[*] [b]SFX[/b] - animal sound scales with maturity, with infants sounding chirpier and higher pitched than their adult counterparts
[*] [b]Behavior[/b] - as babies, animals form clutches and follow their adopted family around the park[/list]Through the Animal Nursery and various game settings, players are now able to control:
[list][*] [b]Animal Neoteny[/b]
[*] [b]Animal Growth Speed[/b][/list][*] [b]NEW FEATURE: Animal Herding and Social Groups[/b]
Animals now form social groups! Depending on the species, they’ll follow their group leader and synchronize behavior (eating, drinking, resting, etc.) to varying degrees. Infants can also be adopted by adult animals, though they won’t contribute to a social group until reaching adolescence. If infants cannot find an adult, they’ll stick together regardless, depending on the species.

If a group leader is missing herd members (e.g. not enough males/females) they will broadcast across the park, making their presence known.
[*] [b]NEW FEATURE: First Person Mode[/b]
A first person mode has been added to the game, accessible from the camera menu (bottom right of the main HUD). This new game mode allows for two alternative play styles:
[list][*] GUI ON: toggleable by having the game GUI on screen. This allows for the full creativity suite while in first person
[*] Full interaction: normal Prehistoric Kingdom gameplay is disabled, while new interaction is unlocked: the player can interact with fence gates, seating, binoculars, and more![/list][*] [b]NEW CHANGE: Animal Locomotion v3[/b]
Animal locomotion has been improved once more with the intent to tidy up and polish the movement introduced in Update 9. The following have been changed/added: [list]
[*] All animals now have trot animations
[*] All animals now have baby animations
[*] Animals will now move between walk, trot and run more discretely, preventing animation blending from happening for too long
[*] Animals will now generally transition between all animations more seamlessly
[*] Animals will now have a chance for zoomies, causing them to run around their paddock. This is more likely as a baby and varies per species
[*] Animals are less prone to slowing down while moving forward[/list][*] [b]NEW CHANGE: Animal Socialization and Awareness[/b]
Animals of the same species will now talk to each other, issuing a call and response. This cannot happen if animals are unable to see one another. If their welfare is too low, animals will play a sad call. If their welfare is extremely low, they’ll play an angry call.
[*] [b]NEW CHANGE: Improved Animal Sexual Dimorphism[/b]
Many species such as Triceratops, Styracosaurus and the Mammoth now feature physical sexual dimorphism, giving females shorter tusks, horns and a more gracile appearance
[*] [b]NEW CHANGE: Improved Animal Alt Species[/b]
Updated the models and proportions for the following animals to make them more distinct:
[list]
[*] Apatosaurus and Brontosaurus
[*] Charonosaurus, Parasaurolophus cyrtocristatus and walkeri
[*] Juxia, Paraceratherium bugtiense and transouralicum
[*] Psittacosaurus sp, sibiricus and mongoliensis
[*] Smilodon fatalis and populator
[*] Camarasaurus grandis, lentus and supremus
[*] Pachyrhinosaurus canadensis, lakustai and perotorum
[*] Elasmotherium and Sinotherium
[*] Plateosaurus trossingensis and gracilis[/list][*] [b]NEW BEHAVIOR: Animal Play Chase[/b]
When an animal wants to socialise, there is a small chance to initiate play with another animal, chasing them in a circular area. This behavior is common in most babies, though can be observed infrequently on the following adults: Coelophysis, Dryosaurus, Juxia, Leaellynasaura, Nasutoceratops, Ouranosaurus, Protoceratops, Psittacosaurus (all), Scelidosaurus, Ugrunaaluk, Velociraptor[/list][h2]Additions[/h2][list]
[*] [b]Gameplay[/b][list]
[*] With the addition of animal ontogeny, we restructured the Biology research tree to account for various new animal features. The following research items were added:[list]
[*] [b]Accelerated Ontogenic Synthesis[/b] - improves pricing and timing requirements for breeding full adult animals
[*] [b]Induced Androgenesis[/b] - ability to breed male animals in the Animal Nursery
[*] [b]Rapid Genetic Replication[/b] - multiplies the breeding speed of animals in the Animal Nursery by 100%
[*] [b]Hyper Genetic Replication[/b] - multiplies the breeding speed of animals in the Animal Nursery by 200%
[*] [b]Suppressed Ontogeny[/b] - enables stopping an animal’s growth at a chosen moment in its growth cycle
[*] [b]Ontogenic Regulation[/b] - enables modifying an animal’s growth cycle speed
[*] [b]Capacity Protocol #1[/b] - Increases the Animal Nursery capacity to 10 slots
[*] [b]Capacity Protocol #2[/b] - Increases the Animal Nursery capacity to 15 slots
[*] [b]Dynamic Replication Allocation[/b] - Increases the Animal Nursery capacity to 60 slots
[/list][*] Added new Park Issue for staff not being able to access an enclosure
[*] Added new Park Issue for animals not having enough room to grow
[*] Added new Park Issue for shops not having a cashier present
[*] Added new Park Issue for not having a Compost Heap in the park
[*] Checklist Park Issues now have click-through behavior to quickly place the required module[/list][*] [b]Animals[/b][list]
[*] Animals will now consider their vertical reach when deciding which feeders they can use (primarily affecting the Tall Feeder). This is influenced by their current size, so infant sauropods will need ground food to start out with. Animals which can access high food sources will prefer them
[*] Added an idle shake and additive head throw animation to Megaloceros[/list][*] [b]UI/UX[/b][list]
[*] Added new report tooltips to the Park Rating and Visitor Satisfaction buttons on the bottom left of the main HUD, giving players information about their parks at a glance
[*] Added activity description text to the animal tooltip and the animal item rects in the Animals Management Menu
[*] Added an Enrichment tab to the animal Info Menu. Animal enrichment currently consists of Stimulation, provided by enrichment items, and Social Interaction, given by herd group members. At this moment, Stimulation is always maxed out until we can implement more enrichment items in Update 15
[*] Added a Social tab to the animal paleopedia, detailing animal grouping information and family behavior
[*] Added confirmation dialog before loading a game while in a save, notifying the player that any unsaved progress will be lost
[*] Animals now use separate hero renders for the Animal Nursery
[*] Animals now have dedicated skin thumbnails for the Animal Nursery
[*] Animal portrait icons now better reflect the animal’s current visual state, with distinct icons for each skin, sex, age, and genetic skin mutation. This is applied throughout the entire GUI
[*] Added a Biology panel to the Animal Info Menu, reporting current animal statistics such as age, maturity, length, mass, etc.
[*] Added a Social panel to the Animal Info Menu, displaying information about the animal’s current social and family groups, if relevant
[*] Added an icon to the Animal Info Menu header to indicate the animal’s sex
[*] Added selection cycling buttons to the Animal Info Menu header, allowing players to quickly switch between animals of the same species if the animal isn’t contained, or animals of its exhibit if the animal is contained
[*] Added a confirmation window that appears when selling animals, notifying the player of the refund sale price
[*] Animal Management Menu: added the ability to select multiple animals and sell them with a single click
[*] Animal Management Menu: added a ‘Most Popular Animal’ widget on the left sidebar, displaying brief information about your park’s most popular animal and focusing it on click
[*] Animal Management Menu: the ‘Locate’ button on the habitat headers now actually selects and focuses the relevant enclosure/habitat
[*] Added new keybind: ‘Toggle First Person Mode’ set by default to LeftControl+T
[*] Added new keybind: ‘Switch Item Next’ set by default to RightBracket
[*] Added new keybind: ‘Switch Item Previous’ set by default to LeftBracket
[*] Added onto and improved the Options Menu[list]
[*] Changed the visual style for the menu and re-ordered settings categories, based on immediate relevance
[*] Added new first person setting in Audio - First Person Radio Effect, which can toggle a radio filter to the game’s music when using First Person Mode
[*] Added new first person setting in Camera - First Person FOV
[*] Added new first person setting in Camera - First Person Sprint Toggle, switching the control scheme for sprinting to use either a key hold, or a key press
[*] Added new first person setting in Camera - First Person CrouchToggle, switching the control scheme for crouching to use either a key hold, or a key press
[*] Added new first person setting in Camera - Hide Crosshair
[*] Added new GUI setting in Interface - Temperature, switching the game’s temperature labels between Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin
[*] Added new GUI setting in Interface - Distance, switching the game’s measuring labels between metric and imperial[/list][*] Paleopedia articles:[list]
[*] Added Ankylosaurus description
[*] Added Apatosaurus description
[*] Added Brontosaurus description[/list][/list][*] [b]Audio[/b][list]
[*] Added a number of new UI sounds to various buttons and sliders to improve the user experience, replacing many of the old sounds
[*] Added ambient building sounds to the Fossil Depot, Research Station and Staff Center modules
[*] Added growls to T. rex eat[/list][*] [b]Music[/b][list]
[*] Added dynamic variants to many tracks, changing the musical fullness/arrangement depending on the time of day, park rating, weather or building activity
[*] Added dynamic and semi-procedural pause music (around 25 minutes of material that plays randomly and adjusts layers depending on player input and location)
[*] Added 2 new Ambient tracks:[list]
[*] It’s Yours (2:52)
[*] Night Life (3:56)[/list][*] Added 2 new Building tracks:[list]
[*] Evolution (1:55)
[*] World’s Greatest Potential (3:43)[/list][*] Added piano variants to 2 Ambient tracks:[list][*] The New World (1:42)
[*] Perniciem (2:10)[/list][*] Entering first person mode will cause music to sound radio-like and filtered. This can be turned off in the game options
[/list][/list][h2]Changes[/h2][list]
[*] [b]Balance[/b][list]
[*] Animals have received a substantial round of rebalancing:[list]
[*] All animal costs have been re-tuned, with a higher overall cost ceiling. Animal pricing is now fully automated, with costs being mathematically based on the animal’s mass and perceived popularity
[*] Animal pricing is now plastic, changing in real-time over the animal’s age and taking into account the animal’s appeal. High appeal animals are now worth more in-game money, which is reflected when selling individuals
[*] Rebalanced animal base appeal points to be mathematically based on the animal’s mass and perceived popularity
[*] Animal base appeal now slightly varies for each individual, based on their current mass
[*] Increased animal starvation and dehydration time by 2x and 1.5x respectively, making animals eat/drink less frequently[/list][*] Base price for science projects (excavations, research items) is about x2 higher
[*] Additional funding levels in the Excavations Menu now have a higher cost, but also a higher fossil yield
[*] Demolishing modular structures now refunds you with half the original cost[/list][*] [b]Gameplay[/b][list]
[*] Excavation system: animals can now be found in multiple excavation sites. When a species is unlocked in a specific site, that will update in all the other sites that species is present in. This currently extends to:[list]
[*] Kökşetau Fm. has been replaced with Kozhamzhar Fm. where Elasmotherium and Mammuthus can be found.
[*] Psittacosaurus mongoliensis is now found in Dushihin Fm. and Jiufotang Fm.
[*] Edmontosaurus regalis is now found in Prince Creek Fm. and Horseshoe Canyon Fm.
[*] Vilyuy River has been re-added to the game, containing Coelodonta
[*] Yamal Peninsula has been re-added to the game, containing Mammuthus and Elasmotherium
[*] Science Teams are now automatically acquired once their specific unlock rating is reached[/list][*] Animal creation: each animal instance now progresses asynchronously in the Nursery Holder
[*] Added the ‘Animal Aging’ gameplay setting: this can completely disable animal aging in Sandbox Mode
[*] Added the ‘Animal Ontogeny Speed Multiplier’ gameplay setting: this is a global value that affects all [*] animal growth speeds in Sandbox Mode, as long as their growth speed isn’t set to ‘Realistic’[/list][*] [b]Animals[/b][list]
[*] Updated Torvosaurus - changed body morphology, skeletal proportion and animations. The new Torvosaurus should be more anatomically accurate and in line with the quality of the other animals in the game
[*] Animal AI now has a more advanced planning and execution model, allowing them to “think” about new things while still performing their current state, which prevents them from constantly being interrupted by thoughts they can’t currently execute on anyway
[*] Animals will perform animation one shots at the end of their pathfinding, rather than stopping randomly
[*] Animal locomotion speeds more accurately reflect their raw animations, leading to overall faster and more alive feeling animals
[*] Updated social needs for all animals
[*] Adjusted the water affinity for many species, generally making them less water inclined

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/ad3d23456b2e8789dda075e135d6ee1b51984308.png[/img]

Welcome, [b]Park Testers[/b]!

This PTB release adds an updated Torvosaurus model, a new social tab to the paleopedia, smooths out animal locomotion and updates the social needs for all animals! We've also deployed fixes for issues pertaining to herding. Joining a herd will now interrupt an animal's current state, reducing the "scattering" effect reported by players. They will also no longer space themselves equally around the leader, congregating in a wider space instead.

A new behavior has also been added: play chasing! When an animal wants to socialise, there is a small chance to initiate play with another animal, chasing them in a circular area. This behavior is more common in babies than adult animals and only applies to more social or active species.

[b]First Person Mode is also now accessed through a button next to the camera settings[/b], making it easier to jump in and out. Of course, players can still use Control + T as a shortcut. Various fixes have also been deployed, so please give the full patch notes a read!

[h3]How to Access the Public Testing Branch (Experimental!)[/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png[/img]
The Public Testing Branch (PTB) is a version of Prehistoric Kingdom that can be opted-into on Steam, containing experimental and potentially breaking changes. With the help of the community, we're able to hunt down various issues and gather feedback before pushing a an update to the public version of Prehistoric Kingdom. 
[olist]
[*] Right click Prehistoric Kingdom in your Steam Library
[*] Go to Properties
[*] Betas
[*] Select 'ptb_public_testing'[/olist]Please note that [b]it is not recommended to play Public Testing Branch parks on earlier versions of the game.[/b] Please send feedback and bug reports to our [url=https://discord.com/invite/pkgame]Discord server's[/url] appropriate channel.

[h3]Known Issues & Additional Notes[/h3][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png[/img][list]
[*] Critical: modular lighting is not recolorable
[*] Issue: animal avoidance is currently broken, so animals can end up walking through each other
[*] Issue: additive animations can trigger during one shots or right before animals go to eat/drink/rest. We would like to stop this from happening to prevent jank
[*] Issue: animal animations in the Animal Nursery are currently broken due to the addition of babies, we will be fixing this[/list]

[h1]Full Patch Notes[/h1]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30171105/1c33bce2a89fdb13be17ee5c61152e072e4201b2.png[/img]
[h2]Features[/h2][list]
[*] [b]NEW BEHAVIOR: Animal Play Chase[/b]
When an animal wants to socialise, there is a small chance to initiate play with another animal, chasing them in a circular area. This behavior is more common in babies than adult animals and only applies to more social or active animals.[/list][h2]Additions[/h2][list]
[*] [b]Animals[/b][list]
[*] Added baby and trot locomotion animations to Ankylosaurus
[*] Added baby and trot locomotion animations to Dilophosaurus
[*] Added baby and trot locomotion animations to Smilodon[/list][b]UI/UX[/b][list][*] Added an Enrichment tab to the animal Info Menu. Animal enrichment currently consists of Stimulation, provided by enrichment items, and Social Interaction, given by herd group members. At this moment, Stimulation is always maxed out until we can implement more enrichment items in Update 15
